title: 第1504章 设计魏坤行动开始第1503章 秦延军个人计划
content_zh:
密室之内，符文如星点般在黑暗中闪烁，空气中弥漫着古老而晦涩的气息。
秦延军端坐于中央，身前一道由混沌元气凝聚而成的模糊光影微微摇曳，那是他通过特殊秘法联系上的“老朋友”。
“‘破界石’和‘混沌源晶’已按计划运抵指定地点。”光影中传来沙哑而低沉的声音，“只是，二十八重天的天地禁制比预想的更为牢固，恐怕需要更强的力量才能在短时间内撕开一道可供你我通行的口子。”
秦延军眉头微蹙，指尖无意识地敲击着扶手：“我知道。诛神阵的核心部件，进展如何？”
“其他部件皆已齐备，只差最后一块‘镇魂玉’。”光影顿了顿，语气凝重，“此物在‘执法殿’副殿主魏坤手中。此人修为深不可测，且极为警惕，寻常手段难以接近。”
“魏坤……”秦延军眼中寒光一闪而过，“看来，需要给他找点麻烦，引开他的注意力了。思宇他们那边，训练强度再加一倍，尤其是思涵的‘幻灵术’，必须在动手前达到小成，或许能在关键时刻派上用场。”
光影恭敬应是，随即化作点点光斑消散于空气中。
密室重归寂静，秦延军起身，走到一面水镜前，镜中映出的并非他自己，而是聚灵阵中秦青的身影。
此刻的聚灵阵内，灵气浓郁得几乎化为实质的云雾。
秦青盘坐于阵眼，小脸专注，呼吸悠长而平稳。按照“父亲”教导的法诀，她引导着周围的灵气缓缓涌入体内，每一次周天运转，都能感觉到丹田内的灵力更加凝实一分。
但今天，秦延军并未让她单纯修炼，而是再次引导她去感受那些“不和谐”的因子。
“青儿，放松心神，不要刻意去捕捉，用心去‘看’，去‘听’……”秦延军的声音仿佛跨越了空间，直接在她脑海中响起。
秦青依言照做，渐渐摒除了所有杂念。
起初，她只能感受到精纯而温和的天地灵气，如同平静的湖面。
但渐渐地，在“父亲”的引导下，她仿佛看到那平静湖面之下，偶尔会泛起一丝丝极细微、极隐晦的黑色涟漪。
这些涟漪与周围的灵气格格不入，它们桀骜不驯，不受任何规则的约束，带着一种原始、狂暴且强大的力量。它们触碰之处，连精纯的灵气似乎都要被扭曲、吞噬。
“这……就是混沌气息吗？”秦青喃喃自语，小小的身躯因为这种陌生的接触而微微颤抖，心中既有好奇，也有一丝本能的畏惧。
“别怕，青儿。”秦延军的声音再次传来，带着一丝鼓励，“它们并非洪水猛兽。你看，它们虽然‘不和谐’，但也代表着一种不受束缚的可能。”
秦延军的目光从水镜上移开，望向窗外，眼中闪过一丝复杂。他要找的“破界石”和“混沌源晶”，正是与这混沌气息息息相关。
而引导青儿提前感受这股力量，不仅是为了让她将来能更好地适应混沌环境，或许，也是在为启动诛神阵，积蓄一种意想不到的变数。

“记住这种感觉，青儿。”秦延军的声音带着不容置疑的坚定，“它们不是敌人，或许，有一天，它们会成为你我打破这狗屁秩序，获得自由的关键助力。”
水镜中，秦青似懂非懂地点了点头，她努力记住那些黑色涟漪的感觉，它们虽然诡异，却隐隐让她感到一种莫名的亲切，仿佛那才是更真实、更自由的力量。
秦延军关闭了水镜，重新将目光投向那幅描绘着二十八重天势力分布的星图。
手指重重地落在了执法殿的位置，低声道：“魏坤……镇魂玉……秩序？那就先从你们开始打破！”
他的眼中，希望与决心交织，而那希望的核心，正是聚灵阵中那个正在懵懂感知混沌力量的小小身影。
一场围绕着诛神阵，关乎命运与格局的风暴，正在他冷静的布局和“女儿”悄然的成长中，加速酝酿。
秦延军负手立于星图前，指尖在“执法殿”三个字上反复摩挲，眼中寒光闪烁。
魏坤，执法殿的殿主，二十八重天秩序的坚定维护者，也是他计划中必须拔除的第一颗钉子。
此人修为深不可测，据说已半步踏入天尊之境，更手握镇魂玉这等镇压神魂的至宝，寻常手段绝难奏效。
“魏坤……”秦延军低声自语，“你以为凭镇魂玉就能锁住一切？就能代表所谓的‘秩序’？”
他缓缓踱步，思绪飞速运转。
直接强攻执法殿，无异于打草惊蛇，且魏坤老奸巨猾，必定布下天罗地网。
更何况，自己的三个子女还在闭关冲击天尊境的关键时刻，绝不能让他们分心，更不能让他们暴露在执法殿的锋芒之下。
“青儿这边，混沌感知尚需时日才能稳固，聚灵阵的效果也才刚刚显现。诛神阵的启动，更是需要破界石与混沌源晶作为核心。”秦延军条理清晰地梳理着关键节点，“魏坤是阻碍，却也可能是……钥匙。”
一个大胆的计划在他心中逐渐成型。
秦延军眼中闪过一丝狡黠。他需要一个契机，一个能让魏坤离开执法殿老巢，且心神不宁的契机。
他想到了一个人——魏坤那个不成器，却又极为疼爱的独子，魏明。此子仗着父亲的权势，在二十八重天横行霸道，仇家不少，但碍于魏坤的威严，无人敢动。
“就从魏明下手。”秦延军嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，“不需要伤他性命，只需让他‘失踪’几日，魏坤必定心焦如焚。执法殿内部并非铁板一块，魏坤一离开，必有破绽。”
他屈指一弹，一道微不可查的黑影从指尖窜出，融入阴影之中，那是他培养的暗卫，专门负责处理一些事务。
在魏坤因儿子“失踪”而方寸大乱，离开执法殿亲自搜寻之际，便是秦延军潜入的最佳时机。

执法殿的防御固然严密，但秦延军早已通过多年的布局，安插了眼线，对执法殿的防御阵法、巡逻路线了如指掌。
秦延军的这个设想真的能成功吗？会不会引来更严重的麻烦？敬请期待！

content_en:
In the secret room, runes shone like stars in the darkness, and the air was filled with an ancient and obscure atmosphere.
Qin Yanjun was sitting in the center, with a blur of light and shadow condensed from chaotic energy swaying slightly in front of him. It was the "old friend" he had contacted through a special secret method.
"The 'Boundary Breaking Stone' and 'Chaos Source Crystal' have been transported to the designated location as planned." A hoarse and deep voice came from the light and shadow, "It's just that the restriction of heaven and earth in the twenty-eighth heaven is stronger than expected. I'm afraid it will take a stronger force to open a hole for you and me to pass in a short time."
Qin Yanjun frowned slightly and tapped the handrail unconsciously with his fingertips: "I know. How is the progress of the core components of the God-killing Formation?"
"All the other parts are ready, only the last piece of 'soul-soothing jade' is missing." Guangying paused, and said in a solemn tone, "This object is in the hands of Wei Kun, the deputy head of the 'Law Enforcement Hall'. This person's cultivation is unfathomable, and he is extremely vigilant, making it difficult to approach with ordinary means."
"Wei Kun..." A cold light flashed in Qin Yanjun's eyes, "It seems that we need to cause him some trouble to distract him. Siyu and the others should double the training intensity, especially Sihan's 'Phantom Spirit Technique', which must be completed before taking action. It may come in handy at a critical moment."
The light and shadow responded respectfully, and then turned into specks of light and dissipated in the air.
Silence returned to the secret room. Qin Yanjun stood up and walked to a water mirror. What was reflected in the mirror was not himself, but Qin Qing's figure in the spirit gathering formation.
In the spirit gathering array at this moment, the spiritual energy was so dense that it almost turned into a substantial cloud.
Qin Qing sat cross-legged in front of the formation, her face focused and her breathing long and steady. According to the techniques taught by her "father", she guided the spiritual energy around her to slowly flow into her body. Every time she moved around, she could feel the spiritual energy in her Dantian becoming more solid.
But today, Qin Yanjun did not let her simply practice, but once again guided her to feel those "disharmonious" factors.
"Qing'er, relax your mind, don't catch it deliberately, 'see' and 'listen' with your heart..." Qin Yanjun's voice seemed to span the space and directly sounded in her mind.
Qin Qing did as he was told and gradually got rid of all distracting thoughts.
At first, she could only feel the pure and gentle aura of heaven and earth, like a calm lake.
But gradually, under the guidance of her "father", she seemed to see that under the calm lake, there were occasionally very subtle and very obscure black ripples.
These ripples are incompatible with the surrounding aura. They are unruly and unconstrained by any rules, carrying a primitive, violent and powerful power. Wherever they touch, even the pure spiritual energy seems to be distorted and swallowed.
"Is this... the aura of chaos?" Qin Qing murmured to herself, her small body trembling slightly because of this unfamiliar contact. There was both curiosity and a hint of instinctive fear in her heart.
"Don't be afraid, Qing'er." Qin Yanjun's voice came again, with a hint of encouragement, "They are not savage beasts. You see, although they are 'disharmonious', they also represent an unfettered possibility."
Qin Yanjun looked away from the water mirror and looked out the window, with a hint of complexity flashing in his eyes. The "boundary-breaking stone" and "chaos source crystal" he was looking for were closely related to this aura of chaos.
Guiding Qing'er to experience this power in advance is not only to allow her to better adapt to the chaotic environment in the future, but perhaps also to accumulate an unexpected variable for activating the God-killing Formation.
"Remember this feeling, Qing'er." Qin Yanjun's voice was unquestionable and firm, "They are not enemies. Perhaps, one day, they will be the key to helping you and I break this bullshit order and gain freedom."
In the water mirror, Qin Qing nodded as if she understood. She tried to remember the feeling of those black ripples. Although they were weird, they made her feel an inexplicable kindness, as if that was more real and natural.by the power of.
Qin Yanjun closed the water mirror and turned his attention again to the star map depicting the distribution of forces in the twenty-eighth heaven.
His fingers landed heavily on the position of the Law Enforcement Hall, and he whispered: "Wei Kun...soul-suppressing jade...order? Then let's break it starting with you!"
In his eyes, hope and determination intertwined, and the core of that hope was the little figure in the spirit gathering array who was ignorantly sensing the power of chaos.
A storm surrounding the God-Slaying Formation, related to fate and structure, is brewing at a faster pace due to his calm layout and the quiet growth of his "daughter".
Qin Yanjun stood in front of the star chart with his hands behind his hands, his fingertips repeatedly rubbing the words "Law Enforcement Hall", and a cold light flashed in his eyes.
Wei Kun, the master of the Law Enforcement Hall, a staunch defender of the order of the twenty-eighth heaven, is also the first nail that must be removed in his plan.
This person's cultivation level is unfathomable. It is said that he has half-stepped into the realm of the Heavenly Lord, and he even holds the soul-suppressing jade and other treasures that can suppress the soul. Ordinary methods will never work.
"Wei Kun..." Qin Yanjun whispered to himself, "Do you think you can lock everything with the soul-suppressing jade? Can it represent the so-called 'order'?"
He paces slowly, his thoughts racing.
Directly attacking the Law Enforcement Hall would be tantamount to arousing the enemy, and Wei Kun was so cunning that he would definitely lay a dragnet.
What's more, his three children are still in seclusion at the critical moment of reaching the Tianzun realm. They must not be distracted, let alone exposed to the sharp edge of the Law Enforcement Hall.
"On Qing'er's side, it will take some time for the chaos perception to be stable, and the effect of the Spirit Gathering Formation has just begun to appear. The activation of the God-killing Formation requires the Boundary Breaking Stone and the Chaos Source Crystal as the core." Qin Yanjun sorted out the key nodes in a clear manner, "Wei Kun is an obstacle, but it may also be... the key."
A bold plan gradually took shape in his mind.
A hint of cunning flashed in Qin Yanjun's eyes. He needed an opportunity, an opportunity that could make Wei Kun leave his nest in the Law Enforcement Hall and feel restless.
He thought of one person - Wei Kun's useless but extremely beloved only son, Wei Ming. Relying on his father's power, this son was tyrannical in the twenty-eighth heaven. He had many enemies, but due to Wei Kun's majesty, no one dared to touch him.
"Let's start with Wei Ming." Qin Yanjun raised a sneer at the corner of his mouth. "We don't need to hurt his life. We only need to make him 'missing' for a few days. Wei Kun will definitely be worried. The interior of the Law Enforcement Hall is not monolithic. Once Wei Kun leaves, there will be flaws."
With a flick of his finger, an undetectable shadow emerged from his fingertips and blended into the shadows. It was the secret guard he had trained to handle certain affairs.
When Wei Kun was in chaos because of his son's "disappearance" and left the Law Enforcement Hall to search personally, it was the best time for Qin Yanjun to sneak in.
Although the defense of the Law Enforcement Hall is tight, Qin Yanjun has already laid out the layout for many years and has placed informants, and he knows the defense formations and patrol routes of the Law Enforcement Hall well.
Can Qin Yanjun's idea really succeed? Will it cause more serious trouble? Stay tuned!
